C_GRID       = "#EEEEEE"
C_ZERO_RING  = "#1A7A6D"

BEAMS = [1, 2, 4, 8]
BUBBLE_SCALE = 600
BUBBLE_ALPHA = 0.18


def _total_viol(d):
    if d is None:
        return 0
    return d.get("dr", 0) + d.get("cf", 0) + d.get("rv", 0)


def _extract(data, mode):
    xs, ys, viols = [], [], []
    for k in BEAMS:
        entry = data[k].get(mode)
        if entry is not None and entry.get("rf1") is not None:
            xs.append(k)
            ys.append(entry["rf1"])
            viols.append(_total_viol(entry))
    return xs, ys, viols


def _draw_series(ax, data, mode, color, marker, ls, label, msize=6):
    xs, ys, viols = _extract(data, mode)
    if not xs:
        return
    ax.plot(xs, ys, color=color, marker=marker,
            markersize=msize, linewidth=1.3, linestyle=ls,
            label=label, zorder=3, markeredgecolor="white",
            markeredgewidth=0.5)
    for x, y, v in zip(xs, ys, viols):
        if v > 0:
            ax.scatter(x, y, s=v * BUBBLE_SCALE, color=color,
                       alpha=BUBBLE_ALPHA, zorder=2, edgecolors="none")


def _mark_zero_viols(ax, data):
    for mode in ("unc", "con"):
        for k in BEAMS:
            entry = data[k].get(mode)
            if entry is not None and entry.get("rf1") is not None and _total_viol(entry) == 0:
                ax.scatter(k, entry["rf1"], s=140, facecolors="none",
                           edgecolors=C_ZERO_RING, linewidths=1.5,
                           zorder=4)


def _format_axes(ax, title):
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=C_DEEP_INDIGO,
                 pad=10, fontfamily="serif")
    ax.set_xlabel("Beam Width ($k$)", fontsize=9.5, fontfamily="serif",
                  color="#444444")
    ax.set_ylabel("R-F1", fontsize=9.5, fontfamily="serif", color="#444444")
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.set_xticks(BEAMS)
    ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
    ax.minorticks_off()
    ax.set_xlim(0.75, 11)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8.5, colors="#555555")
    ax.grid(True, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for spine in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
    for spine in ("bottom", "left"):
        ax.spines[spine].set_linewidth(0.5)
        ax.spines[spine].set_color("#CCCCCC")


def _add_pareto_star(ax, x, y):
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=350, marker="*", color="white",
               edgecolors="none", zorder=5)
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=280, marker="*", color=C_GOLD,
               edgecolors="#8B7355", linewidths=0.5, zorder=6)

    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.family": "serif",

        "ytick.major.width": 0.4,

                          facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=0.8, zorder=zorder)

                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=color,
                                lw=lw, linestyle=style,
                                shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2),
                zorder=2)

def arrow_label(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, label, color=ARROW_C, style="-", lw=0.8,
                label_pos=0.5, offset=(0, 0.015)):
    arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=color, style=style, lw=lw)
    mx = x1 + (x2 - x1) * label_pos + offset[0]
    my = y1 + (y2 - y1) * label_pos + offset[1]

    ax.add_patch(poly)
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs,
            color=TEXT_DARK, fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", zorder=4)

    from matplotlib.patches import Ellipse
